BlockDesc.XXXX0: I need you to <style=DialogTerm>pilfer</style> some dropboxes for me. They are just lying around waiting for us.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.1: I've learned that {10} has stored some valuable material in some dropboxes.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.2: For now, they have been carelessly left out in the open, but it won't be long before {10} realizes and moves them to more secure storage.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.3: They don't know what they have?
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.4: Not yet. My insider 'misfiled' the summary report, but that won't last forever.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.5: They slipped me a copy of the summary, knowing I'd be interested.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.6: A stealth job. We'll look at the plan and consider it.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.7: I want to steal these dropboxes before anyone at {10} gets smart and moves them.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.8: An evening of quiet theft? I think we can do that.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.9_Male: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Pilfer</style> job. We must search the facility, picking up the dropboxes. We will be paid for each <style=DialogTerm>Dropbox</style> we can steal.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer.9_Female: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Pilfer</style> job. We must search the facility, picking up the dropboxes. We will be paid for each <style=DialogTerm>Dropbox</style> we can steal.
M_PGen_Pilfer.MissionDesc.1.Male: {10} has left 3 dropboxes with important data around the site. {1} wants what is in the dropboxes and our job is to fetch them.
M_PGen_Pilfer.MissionDesc.1.Female: {10} has left 3 dropboxes with important data around the site. {1} wants what is in the dropboxes and our job is to fetch them.
M_PGen_Pilfer.RoomDesc: Each Dropbox we pick up will increase our payday.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Intro.2: The dropboxes are scattered all over. Three of them in different locations.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Intro.3: Why aren't the all together in one place?
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Intro.4: Who knows? An attempt at security? Or maybe they don't know what is in each one?
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Intro.5: It doesn't matter. We have our targets.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Intro.6: Let's get as many as we can. Move out.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Intro.7: The three dropboxes are sitting in different places across the zone. Plan a route to pick up as many as we can. Once we have one of the three dropboxes, we will be free to extract, but our payment increases with each dropbox.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Done.1: There is still more to pick up. Keep going.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Done.2: We have partial mission success! We can successfully extract now or keep looking for the additional dropboxes.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Done.3_Male: That's the last dropbox. Let's get these back to {1}.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Done.3_Female: That's the last dropbox. Let's get these back to {1}.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Exit.2: Scatter and meet back at the Safehouse.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Victory.1: We were only able to get some of the dropboxes.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Victory.2: We got them all. Three dropboxess for you.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Victory.3: Excellent work. You slipped in and out with what I wanted.
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Defeat.1: That was bad. We couldn't even get one dropbox!
Dialog.D_PGen_Pilfer_Defeat.3: There were too many defenses. We couldn't breach them.
